sentences.text:
PER COURT :-
1. Heard the learned counsel for the applicant and the learned A.P.P. for respondent/State.
2. The applicant is seeking bail in C.R.No.103 of 2023 registered with Police Station, Naldurg,
District Osmanabad, for the offence punishable under Sections 188, 328, 272, 273 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 26(2)(i), 27(2)(e), 30(2)(a), 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 read with Rules 2, 3, 4 of the Regulation, 2011.
Section 328 of the Indian Penal Code would attract or not in the cases of gutka (scented tobacco) is seized with the Honourable Supreme Court.
The Honourable Supreme Court granted bail to the accused seizing in such cases.
Except Section 328 of the Indian Penal Code, the other Sections 2 933-BA-590-23.odt are bailable.
In view of that matter, the applicant deserve bail.

Hence, the following order :-
i) Application is allowed.
